purpose: Identify a source-data-learned update-rate function within a canonical predictive-map model; source-only functionalmodel, not anatomical mechanism or crossspecies/agent result.
prior_work: Originalsource SR and olderlocalparameter/memory-decay fits exist; this adds normalizedsurprise/pastoutcome-dependent update-rate functions and recovery/heldoutcontrols. Adaptivelearningrates themselves notnovel.

boundary: Read/export native1-7 only; no native8-25fit/score or crossspeciesdirection/agentfit GO. Olderwholedataanalyses known, exploratorysource work.

native_semantics.position: Observedfirstcell, not nominalstart; no syntheticprepend/goalappend; retain all observedmoves and nativeflags.
native_semantics.goal: Designgoalstate34=(3,3), known source task/pretraining prior, not a new observedneuralstate.
native_semantics.clock: One modelupdate perobserved movingtransition; no physical/ms equivalence; blockedattempts/waiting notobserved.
native_semantics.reward_history: Initial.5; exponentiallyweighted completed-trial native success,decay.8; update onlyafter completeobservedtrial, no per-move fake reward.
native_semantics.missing_trials: Unknownomittedtrials detected by publishedarray ordinal gaps; reset outcomehistory to.5atgap, latentM retains modeledobservedupdates asdeclaredconditional replay. No imputedfeedback.
native_semantics.order: Releasedconfiguration/trial arrayorder as in originalsource model, not independent physicaltimestampverification.
native_semantics.legal_information: Choice likelihood conditioned on observedmovement using currentgeometrylegal neighbors; sourceinformationprior, not retinal/perception parity.

model.choice: softmax(beta*M[nextcandidate,goal]+kappa*samepreviousmove), legalneighbors only; predict before current observedtransition update.
model.locality: Canonicalrow/synapse prediction-error update with global scalarcoefficient; numericalarray implementation, no spiking/energy or observedbiophysicalclaim.

fit.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B finite-difference gradient through deterministicNumba replay
fit.selection: All2species x4families x3gamma x2starts before sourcevalidation interpretation. Withinfamily bestvalidation meanindividualper-moveLL; ties trainLL thenlowergamma/startindex. Compare each bestfamily tobestconstant; all failures/choices retained.

recovery.design: 4groundtruthfunctions x rat6/human12trainingcohorts x3fixedseeds100/101/102. Same sourcegeometry/observedfirstposes/trialinventory andnative observedmove count ascap; sampledlegalmoves untilgoal/cap. Fullysyntheticoutcomes anddifferentresultingmovementcounts reported.
recovery.interpretation: Recovery required beforemechanistic/transportclaims; poorrecovery is model/data limitation, not absentbiology.

future_gate: Sourceheldoutbenefit andfunctionalrecovery before nativecrossspecies/agenttarget protocols. Do nottransferraw learningrate numbers intoeprop.
